note: Letter from the anonymous old man, U06110-U06116; polite, formal register. Line breaks redistributed within the unit; line count kept.

en:
Thanks to him, I was able to
achieve a fair measure of
success and build a fortune.

Wishing to repay my debt, I
tried to give Lord Motonari
money, but in the end he
would not accept it.

He said that he had not
helped me with any such
thing in mind.

But that would not put my
heart at ease. And so I
resolved to ask you to
accept it, Lord Terumoto.

However, I feared that even
if I gave it to you directly,
you would surely refuse it
as well, and so I chose to
deliver it in this way.

I beg you, please accept
it as it is.
